content:
Alex W: Heads up — we're seeing intermittent GPU training job slowdowns on rack 14. p95 latency between workers jumps to 120ms then recovers. Not typical.
Priya S: saw that too. Affected jobs are all multi-node BERT fine-tunes using NCCL over rdma. Jobs fall back to TCP briefly.
Mike T: ToR14 (tor-14) CPU usage spiked around the same window. suspect packet fragmentation / reassembly overload.
Carla (oncall): infra-bot alerted: "tor-14 net-queue-depth high, kernel drop counters rising" about 00:08 UTC.
Alex W: stack traces show NCCL timeouts then fallback. Worker logs: "rdma read timeout, retrying over TCP"
Priya S: can someone grab `ethtool -k` and `ip link show` on the affected ToR? Also `show running-config` for ECMP settings on spine?
Mike T: grabbing tcpdump on leaf-facing interface. partial capture: ```15:23:41.123456 IP 10.0.14.2.50020 > 10.0.14.3.50020: Flags [P.], seq 1:1450, ack 1, win 229, length 1449
15:23:41.123789 IP 10.0.14.2 > 10.0.14.3: frag (mtu 9000) ...```
Carla (oncall): I see fragments and MF flags. MTU is 9000 everywhere AFAIK. Could be ECMP path switching that hits a non-jumbo segment?
Alex W: hypothesis: some spine paths have MTU mismatch (non-jumbo) leading to fragmentation on certain ECMP hashes -> extra CPU and reassembly failures -> RDMA falls back.
Priya S: that would also explain per-flow asymmetry. We observed higher packet drop counters on tor-14 egress to spine-2.
Mike T: config diff between spine-1 and spine-2 shows `mtu 9216` on spine-1, and `mtu 1500` on spine-2. Oof.
Carla (oncall): whoa. when did that change happen? deploy-bot shows a maintenance on spine-2 3 hours ago by netops.
Alex W: timeline matches. Jobs started failing ~2.5 hours ago.
Priya S: plan: 1) reconfigure spine-2 MTU to 9216 (maintenance window?) 2) add temporary routing policy to pin RDMA flows to spine-1 3) restart RDMA daemons on affected nodes after maintenance.
Mike T: netops, can you confirm a rolling MTU update across spine-2 won't break anything? We need an ETA.
Carla (oncall): pinging @netops. For now I'm throttling new multi-node GPU job starts on rack 14 to avoid cascading failures. :warning:
infra-bot: Incident note created: INC-2026-1347 — ToR MTU mismatch causing RDMA fallback and GPU job slowdowns.
Priya S: after we fix MTU, we should run a short NCCL allreduce test across rack 14 and rack 15 with large messages to verify no fragmentation.
Alex W: agree. I'll prepare a test harness and coordinate a quick canary.
Mike T: also recommend adding an MTU drift alert: cloudwatch/grafana rule when MTU config differs across spine peers.
Carla (oncall): netops responded: rolling MTU change scheduled in 12m, expected 6m to converge. I'll update INC and pause restarts until then.
Alex W: thanks. marking this thread as the primary coordination channel. Post-fix we'll capture perf graphs and NCCL logs.
Priya S: one more note — long-term we should prefer path-aware ECMP for RDMA workloads to avoid mixing jumbo/non-jumbo links in same ECMP group. :thinking_face:
Mike T: ack.
Carla (oncall): closing loop once netops confirms convergence. :thumbsup:
